content.comment_body: I have reached the maximum limit of 400 function blocks in my project. Is there any method to increase the number of available blocks?
No, it's not possible to expand beyond this limit. You could review your code to see if you can reduce the number of blocks by optimizing your programming approach.
Alternatively, you can add a second [product_name] device and connect them over the network using master/master configuration.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces a fixed limit of 400 function blocks per project, which cannot be bypassed within the current [product_name] application. Others offer suggestions, like refining the programming to use fewer blocks or adding another controller connected by network. This constraint makes scaling up and implementing more complex processes difficult without additional hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to surpass the current 400 function block limit within a single project for greater programming complexity, ideally without needing additional hardware.
